question: 'Tholu Bommalatta’, a shadow puppet theatre tradition, belongs to the state of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tholu Bommalata**__

 
 
• **It is the traditional puppetry art form of Andhra Pradesh, that has lost its sheen. Now, there are only a few artisans to carry forward the art. Hence, Option 1 is correct.**
